attributes.name: decorative effect type
attributes.definition: Which kind of visual effect the page favors for decoration and depth (gradients, shadows, etc.).

values.definition: Gradients are the preferred effect over shadows and other effects.
Shadows are the main effect used for depth.
Effects of any kind are few or absent.
A different or mixed effect approach.

attributes.name: shadow usage
attributes.definition: How much box or element shadow is used on the page.

values.definition: Only one element, such as the hero image, has a soft shadow.
Shadows are applied broadly across components.

attributes.name: motion and transitions
attributes.definition: The amount of animation, transitions and transforms on the page.

values.definition: Few transitions, animations or transforms; restrained motion.

attributes.name: divider decoration
attributes.definition: Presence and weight of decorative dividers between sections.

values.definition: Decorative dividers are few or minimal.
Decorative dividers are a notable feature.
